made_2.title: Two-point basket
made_2.body: A shot made from inside the arc is worth 2 points.

made_3.title: Three-pointer
made_3.body: A shot made with both feet behind the arc is worth 3 points instead of 2.

ft_made.title: Free throw
ft_made.body: After certain fouls the fouled player shoots unguarded from the free-throw line. Each make is worth 1 point.

ft_missed.title: Free throw
ft_missed.body: After certain fouls the fouled player shoots unguarded from the free-throw line. A miss scores nothing and the ball is live for a rebound on the last attempt.

missed_shot.title: Missed shot
missed_shot.body: When a shot misses, either team can grab the rebound and take possession.

foul.title: Personal foul
foul.body: Illegal contact, like pushing, holding or hitting a shooter's arm, is a foul. The other team gets the ball, or free throws if the player was shooting. Players who collect too many fouls must leave the game.

and_one.title: And-one
and_one.body: If a player is fouled while making a shot, the basket still counts and they get 1 extra free throw.

travel.title: Traveling
travel.body: A player holding the ball can't take steps without dribbling. Moving the pivot foot or taking extra steps is a travel, and the other team gets the ball.

turnover.title: Turnover
turnover.body: A turnover is losing the ball to the other team without taking a shot, for example a bad pass or stepping out of bounds.

steal.title: Steal
steal.body: A defender who takes the ball away from the offense, without a foul, gets credit for a steal.

block.title: Block
block.body: A defender who legally deflects a shot on its way up gets credit for a block. Touching it on the way down toward the rim is goaltending, and the basket counts.

rebound.title: Rebound
rebound.body: Grabbing the ball after a missed shot is a rebound. A defensive rebound ends the other team's possession; an offensive rebound gives your team another chance.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.body: A team can stop the clock to rest, talk strategy or break the other team's momentum.
